annotation.interpretation_a: Endpoints are permitted to block all connection attempts to loopback addresses.
annotation.interpretation_b: Endpoints are permitted to allow connection attempts to loopback addresses.
annotation.justification: The use of "MAY" grants discretion, but the lack of any condition makes it ambiguous whether endpoints are allowed to prevent *all* loopback connections or only some. This affects implementation because an implementer must decide when to block loopback connections.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify under what conditions an endpoint would prevent connection attempts. It is unclear if the prevention is conditional or absolute.
